messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: Alert fired - inference-queue-exhaustion (sev: P1) — queue=model-infer-prod backlog ~5k, autoscaler failing to increase desired replicas.

pagerduty: Triggered: inference-queue-exhaustion -> Assigned to sam

sam: ack — looking. grabbing recent autoscaler metrics and provider quota logs

ops-bot: No deploys in last 30m. Autoscaler observed: targetReplicas=10, desiredReplicas=40, actuallyProvisioned=10. scaleAttempts=6, lastError=quota_exceeded

anjali: i'm seeing a flurry of 429s from cloud-quotas API -> GPU pool quotaRemaining=0 for pool GPU-pool-23 across regions, approx 2m ago

leah: KV cache warmup still ~0%, hit rate 0.2%. backlog growth matches cold-kv start windows. looks like many requests hitting cold paths

darren: i'll try manual burst spinup while infra confirms quota. running: `kubectl scale deploy/inference-prod --replicas=60 --namespace=prod`

sam: do that but watch node OOMs. also let's flip non-critical routes to the quantized fallback model to reduce memory pressure

anjali: patching routing now: `PATCH /routes/serve -d '{"traffic_split":{"infer-quant-medium":0.3,"infer-prod":0.7}}'` -> response 202 accepted

ops-bot: routing patch applied, 30% traffic -> infer-quant-medium; observers: immediate latency delta on routed traffic (-400ms p95)

leah: routed traffic latency looks good. overall backlog trending down from 5k -> 3.2k over 4m

pagerduty: ack recorded by sam (4876500008)

sales-ops: FYI support is seeing ~8 customers with 503/504 reports. i'll open a customer comms thread and loop account leads

darren: infra confirmed quota increase approved by provider (quota id Q-98123). autoscaler has new headroom, provisioning new nodes now

ops-bot: nodepool autoscale events: +20 nodes requested, +18 nodes provisioned. autoscaler goal now matches desiredReplicas=40

sam: monitoring shows token generation throughput back to baseline for routed + fallback traffic. final backlog ~200 and dropping

anjali: saving relevant logs and snapshots: s3://redwood-incident-logs/4876500000/ (kube-events, autoscaler-metrics, provider-429-traces)

leah: next steps: tune warmup prefetch, increase KV cache pre-seeding, reduce cold-start SLO impact. will file follow-up with Optimize team

darren: updating runbook to include manual quota fallback steps and a checklist for scale bursts :thumbsup:

sam: assigning action items now: anjali (quota failover automation), leah (warmup & kv prefetch tuning), darren (runbook + ops doc). i'll create the incident ticket and link here

ops-bot: Incident status -> RESOLVED -> degraded->ok. Will auto-close in 2h if no regressions.
